1) Which Portland and full service address? (Street, city, ZIP)

   - Hard-to-reach area / very tight cabinet?

5) Preferred date(s) and rough time window (morning / afternoon / evening)?

Reply with those, and I’ll request multiple local plumber quotes and compare them for you.</action>
